text:
ivy: noticed flaky failures in the Next samplekit (LangChain wiring). Embeddings sometimes arrive out of input order and the eval harness scores change.
noah: rough repro? which sample path + sdk?
ivy: samples/next-samplekit-langchain, @redwood/sdk@0.9.4 (Node). POSTing a single /api/embed with 6 items intermittently yields shuffled ids in the response.
rhea: any logs? seen duplicates or just ordering?
ivy: both. Example log: request ids [t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6] -> responses [t1,t3,t2,t5,t6] and once saw t3 duplicated when a partial retry happened.
oscar: hmm that suggests the JS batch returns as promises resolve and the retry merge appends rather than re-inserting. Python keeps order and dedupes. Parity gap.
noah: can you paste the minimal repro steps in the issue?
ivy: done and attached a tiny payload for CI. Steps: 1) clone samples/next-samplekit-langchain 2) env: REDWOOD_API_KEY set 3) yarn dev 4) curl -X POST /api/embed -d '{"items":[{"id":"t1","text":"..."},...]}' 5) watch server logs for ordering diffs.
noah: opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1300 - "JS: batch embed responses unordered + retry duplicates"
devex-bot: issue #1300 created by noah labels: sdk,bug,parity
ioscar: short-term sample fix?
ivy: I added a tiny helper `stableMapById` in `api/embeds.ts` that maps results by id and reorders into the original sequence, and a dedupe step. I set SAMPLEKIT_STABLE_EMBEDS=true in the sample .env so CI uses the safe path.
rhea: assign people: @oscar please prototype a JS SDK change; @noah add an eval harness test that asserts ordering + no-duplicates; @ivy update sample README with repro + workaround.
oscar: plan: add an opt-in flag `preserveInputOrder` to the JS SDK defaulting to true for parity. Implementation: allocate an array of placeholders and fill them by index as responses arrive; retry merges must write into the original indices and ignore duplicates by client id. I'll bench at 200 qps.
noah: for the harness test I'll add three checks: 1) same set of ids; 2) no duplicates; 3) same ordering. Run at higher concurrency in CI to catch the race.
ivy: sample PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/5821 - adds helper and README note. Preview CI failed so I pinned the env flag there.
devex-bot: preview deploy for pr/5821 rolled back reason: ci/tests:eval-harness failed
noah: good signal. Once SDK PR merges we'll remove SAMPLEKIT_STABLE_EMBEDS and add integration tests to prevent regression.
ioscar: will submit SDK PR this week, include microbench numbers and a changelog entry about stable batching semantics.
rhea: also add an SDK unit test that simulates a partially failed chunk (e.g., 401 mid-batch) and asserts final merge is deduped and in-order.
ivy: thanks team, saved the repro and logs in the issue and added a short note in devex checklist: "samplekit: assume JS batch may reorder unless preserveInputOrder enabled". :memo:
